name: MIP-Splatting
definition: An extension of 3DGS that introduces 2D and 3D Gaussian filters to improve robustness to aliasing caused by resolution changes, focal length variations, or camera distance changes.
summary: MIP-Splatting is an alias-free 3D Gaussian Splatting extension that eliminates spatial aliasing artifacts by applying 3D smoothing and 2D Mip filters to ensure high-quality novel view synthesis across arbitrary scales.
